canonical_name: Poincare inequality for Sobolev functions (exact variant open)
literal_source_claim_en: An L^p estimate for Sobolev functions.
statement_blocker: The catalogue omits the domain, dimension, measure, Sobolev model, exponents, mean-zero or zero-trace/support normalization, weak derivative, norms, constant dependencies, ordered binders, and boundary cases. It also repeats the same attribution, year, and gloss as THM-M-1239. Selecting a standard formulation now would invent missing mathematics and could duplicate another target.
domain_and_universes: Open: an exact source must fix the scalar field, finite-dimensional or general ambient space, domain and regularity, measure, Sobolev construction, exponents, and all Lean universes and typeclass assumptions.
conclusion: Prospective family only: a source-specified L^p quantity of a Sobolev function or its normalized representative is bounded by a source-specified constant times an L^p-type quantity of its weak derivative or gradient. Exact operands, exponents, constant, and quantifiers are open.
